about_the_game:
Man the helm and Dominate the Seas!

Prepare for intense naval combat as you command your ship through relentless battles. Outsmart your enemies, upgrade your firepower, and survive the treacherous waters—because only the strongest will rule the ocean.

Engage in Tactical Warfare

Take the helm of your vessel and engage in high-stakes battles against enemy ships determined to send you to the depths. Experiment with different ship sizes, weapon loadouts, and strategies to overcome evolving challenges. Every battle is a test of skill, survival, and tactical decision-making.

Upgrade, Adapt, and Conquer

Earn experience by sinking enemy ships and surviving the chaos. As you progress, transform your humble torpedo boat into a fearsome warship. Collect points for every second you stay afloat and invest them in upgrades—enhance your firepower, reinforce your hull, or boost your maneuverability to gain the upper hand.

Beware the Tower Islands

Not all threats roam the open sea. Tower islands stand as formidable guardians, ready to obliterate any ship that strays too close. Stay alert, plan your approach, and adapt your strategy because not every ship is built to face every enemy.

The sea is ruthless. Do you have what it takes to survive?

Are you ready to set sail, Captain?
